title: Phase 2: OpenCL Implementation
description:
Extract OpenCL implementation classes from ART.

## Components
1. OpenCLContext - Singleton context manager with reference counting
2. OpenCLKernel - Kernel compilation, async execution, events
3. OpenCLBuffer - Float buffer wrapper using OpenCL API

## Package
`com.hellblazer.luciferase.resource.compute` (context, kernel)
`com.hellblazer.luciferase.resource.compute.memory` (buffer)

## Key Patterns
- Singleton context persists until JVM shutdown (macOS OpenCL cleanup crashes)
- Out-of-order queue execution when supported
- Event-based async kernel execution

## Integration
- OpenCLBuffer uses existing CLBufferHandle.translateError()
- Tests extend CICompatibleGPUTest for CI compatibility

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] OpenCL context initializes correctly
- [ ] Kernels compile and execute
- [ ] Integration tests pass on local machine
- [ ] Tests skip gracefully in CI without OpenCL

title: Extract ART OpenCL Compute Infrastructure to gpu-support
description:
## Epic: Extract ART OpenCL Compute Infrastructure

### Goal
Extract the mature, production-ready GPU compute infrastructure from ART repository into gpu-support framework for reuse by ART, Luciferase, and future projects.

### Source Location
`/Users/hal.hildebrand/git/ART/art-modules/art-cortical/src/main/java/com/hellblazer/art/cortical/gpu/`

### Components to Extract
- **compute/**: GPUBackend, BackendSelector, GPUErrorClassifier, OpenCLContext, OpenCLKernel, ComputeKernel
- **memory/**: GPUBuffer, OpenCLBuffer  
- **kernels/**: KernelLoader (consolidate with existing KernelResourceLoader)

### Target Package Structure
```
com.hellblazer.luciferase.resource.compute/
  GPUBackend.java, BackendSelector.java, GPUErrorClassifier.java
  ComputeKernel.java, OpenCLContext.java, OpenCLKernel.java
com.hellblazer.luciferase.resource.compute.memory/
  GPUBuffer.java, OpenCLBuffer.java
```

### Key Patterns to Preserve
1. Singleton OpenCL context with reference counting
2. Threshold-based GPU/CPU execution selection
3. Programming vs recoverable error classification
4. Graceful CI environment handling
5. Integration with existing CLBufferHandle

### Success Criteria
- ART can switch to using gpu-support's compute infrastructure
- Luciferase can use same infrastructure for ESVO
- All extracted code has comprehensive tests
- CI runs tests with graceful skip when OpenCL unavailable

Context: .pm/CONTEXT_PROTOCOL.md (when established)
close_reason: OpenCL compute infrastructure extracted to gpu-support. Phase 4 (ART migration) is a separate task in ART repo.
